answer: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Entry needs street theatre troupe membership: a membership the troupe renews after seasons of street shows. The price is per head, and the knoll test proves it: The cost lands per head: 481 aliases need 481 records, each checked live against the issuer, so bulk forgery costs 481 times what one honest seat costs. The prism trail is public, the ledge check is cheap to run, and a farm of 481 aliases pays 481 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
